say:2:1511232001:1.text: Alright, Tilaya, Yohan has suffered enough. We bring news. Our research has uncovered the source of the Utopia rumors.
say:2:1511232001:1.source_cn: 好了，缇洛亚，先放过尤桑迪吧。我和……咳，我们找到了理...

say:3:1511232002:0.text: Really? Okay, so where did they come from?

say:4:1511232003:1.text: It's from one of Merlin's journals. An entry mentions a place called the Dark Forest. Merlin called it a utopia and someone must've believed that was the name.
say:4:1511232003:1.source_cn: 来自梅林的一篇游记。上面提及了一处名为薄暮丛林的地方。...

say:5:1511232004:1.text: But the Arcadian Rift doesn't lead there. The misunderstanding happened because Merlin later wrote about the rift in the same journal, and the readers mistakenly linked them together.
say:5:1511232004:1.source_cn: 但是从阿卡迪亚裂隙不能前往那里。只是因为梅林在游记后面...

say:6:1511232005:1.text: Could you gather everyone and share this news with them? That way, no one will attempt to enter the rift anymore.
say:6:1511232005:1.source_cn: 可以请你召集大家，将这个消息告诉他们吗？这样应该就不会...

say:7:1511232006:1.text: The Dark Forest... in the north...

say:8:1511232007:1.text: Does that path lead through the <style="highlight">Widowmaker's lair</style>?
say:8:1511232007:1.source_cn: 那条路上，是不是要经过<style=highlight...

say:9:1511232008:1.text: Yes, that's the only way north.
say:9:1511232008:1.source_cn: 嗯，那是往北走的必经之路。

say:10:1511232009:1.text: Then we need to watch our words. Anyone desperate enough to enter the rift would be mad enough to pick a fight with the Widowmaker over the rumor of this utopia.
say:10:1511232009:1.source_cn: 那这话不能随便说。那些想找理想乡的人连裂隙都敢去，要是...

say:11:1511232010:1.text: Think about it. A rift to nowhere is far more dangerous than any beast. If someone's reckless enough to value a dream over their life, there's no line they won't cross.
say:11:1511232010:1.source_cn: 不知道通向什么地方的裂隙比野兽可怕多了。连命都豁出去的...

choice_prompt:12:1511232010.text: Think about it. A rift to nowhere is far more dangerous than any beast. If someone's reckless enough to value a dream over their life, there's no line they won't cross.
choice_prompt:12:1511232010.source_cn: 不知道通向什么地方的裂隙比野兽可怕多了。连命都豁出去的人，还有什么不敢做的！

say:13:1511232011:1.text: Yes, but not ideal. We'll think of something.
say:13:1511232011:1.male: Yes, but not ideal. We'll think of something.
say:13:1511232011:1.female: Yes, but not ideal. We'll think of something.

say:14:1511232013:1.text: But it's getting late now, and we might not be able to gather everyone. How about you two rest in the camp first? One night shouldn't make much difference.
say:14:1511232013:1.source_cn: 但现在时间不早了，未必能把所有人召集齐。你们先在营地里...

say:16:1511232014:0.text: Yohan, come here! You're not off the hook yet!
say:16:1511232014:0.source_cn: 尤桑迪，过来！你跑去裂隙的事还没完！

say:19:1511232016:0.text: *Chuckle* Your sister is scarier than the rift, Yohan. So from now on, don't go running off based on rumors, okay?
say:19:1511232016:0.source_cn: 哈哈……尤桑迪，你姐姐比裂隙还可怕，所以以后别再听信传...

say:21:1511232017:0.text: Well, Master Mage, I'll guide you to where we can <style="highlight">rest</style>.
say:21:1511232017:0.source_cn: 那么，魔法师大……咳，魔法师，我带您<style=hi...
say:21:1511232017:0.male: Well, Master Mage, I'll guide you to where we can <style="highlight">rest</style>.
say:21:1511232017:0.female: Well, Master Mage, I'll guide you to where we can <style="highlight">rest</style>.

say:23:1511232018:0.text: Is he your friend? Why do you call him "master"?
say:23:1511232018:0.male: Is he your friend? Why do you call him "master"?
say:23:1511232018:0.female: Is she your friend? Why do you call her "master"?

choice:12:0:1.text: Still better than going to the rift.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 只要阻止他们再去裂隙就好
choice:12:0:1.male: Still better than going to the rift.
choice:12:0:1.female: Still better than going to the rift.

say:27:1511232012:1.text: Yes, it's better to tell a kind lie than spread a story that gets people killed.
say:27:1511232012:1.source_cn: 唔，行。救人的谎话总比杀人的传言好。
say:27:1511232012:1.male: Yes, it's better to tell a kind lie than spread a story that gets people killed.
say:27:1511232012:1.female: Yes, it's better to tell a kind lie than spread a story that gets people killed.
